progetti.pageIntro: Every project tells a different story. Over the years, I've worked with startups, SMEs, and organizations across a wide range of industries, designing software solutions, leading technical teams, and developing custom applications. Below is a selection of projects that reflect my approach: understanding the problem, designing the right solution, and delivering it using reliable and scalable technologies.

logistica.title: Evolution of a Warehouse Management System (WMS)
logistica.challenge: A logistics company needed to evolve its Warehouse Management System to support new operational workflows, improve scalability, and integrate with existing enterprise systems.
logistica.role: I designed the software architecture, analyzed business requirements, and supported the development team in making technical decisions throughout the project.
logistica.outcome: Deliver a modular, maintainable platform designed to evolve alongside the company's future needs.

legno.title: Native Mobile Application for Timber Volume Measurement
legno.challenge: A company in the wood industry required a digital solution to automate timber volume calculations, collect precise measurements, and connect directly to digital measuring tools such as laser meters and calipers.
legno.role: I designed the native application's architecture, defined operational workflows, and developed integrations with measuring devices to ensure fast and reliable data collection.
legno.outcome: Develop a simple and efficient application to digitize timber measurement, reduce manual errors, and improve field operations.

volontariato.title: Multi-Site Management Platform for Volunteer Organizations
volontariato.challenge: A volunteer organization with multiple locations needed to digitize warehouse management, orders, and clothing distribution while coordinating users, inventory, and operations across different facilities.
volontariato.role: I designed the software architecture, defined the data model, and supported the design of operational workflows for a multi-user, multi-site platform.
volontariato.outcome: Build a centralized, scalable, and easy-to-use platform to improve inventory traceability, order management, and volunteer coordination.

appNative.title: Native Mobile Applications
appNative.desc: I've developed native mobile applications for businesses across various industries, tailoring each solution to specific requirements. Projects include insurance applications, electric mobility platforms, and software for the wood industry. Every application was built with a strong focus on performance, user experience, and seamless integration with backend services and external APIs.

gestionali.title: Business Management Platform and CRM for Mechanical Workshops
gestionali.desc: I designed and developed a business management platform for craftsmen and mechanical workshops to simplify daily operations. The software centralizes customer management, service jobs, quotations, documentation, and workflows, reducing manual work and improving operational control.

industrialPrinting.title: Tech Lead & Project Management for a White-Label Software Platform
industrialPrinting.challenge: A manufacturer of industrial printers required a white-label software platform capable of supporting multiple customers, custom configurations, and operational processes related to machine management.
industrialPrinting.role: I served as Tech Lead and Project Manager, leading requirements analysis, planning technical activities, coordinating the development team, and monitoring project milestones.
industrialPrinting.outcome: Develop a flexible and customizable software platform capable of adapting to different industrial environments while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.

acquaponica.title: IoT Automation for Aquaponic Greenhouses
acquaponica.challenge: An international project in Australia required the automation of aquaponic greenhouses using intelligent systems capable of monitoring environmental conditions, controlling equipment, and optimizing crop growth processes.
acquaponica.role: I designed the IoT solution architecture, defining the integration between embedded devices, sensors, actuators, and software systems for automated greenhouse monitoring and control.
acquaponica.outcome: Develop a reliable and scalable automation system for smart greenhouse management, improving environmental control while reducing manual intervention.

ricettiva.title: Hospitality Management Platform
ricettiva.desc: For a hospitality business, I developed a solution that centralizes bookings from the main online booking platforms. At the same time, I designed an on-premises infrastructure with a dedicated local server to manage the video surveillance system, ensuring full control over data and recordings.

stampanti.title: Team Management & Scheduling for Industrial Printing Software
stampanti.desc: I led the technical coordination of a desktop software project for industrial printers. In addition to development, I managed planning, team coordination, and task prioritization, ensuring deadlines were met while maintaining high product quality.

crmOfficina.title: Workshop Management CRM
crmOfficina.challenge: A small mechanical workshop needed a digital solution to organize vehicle service operations, maintain a complete maintenance history, and improve customer relationship management.
crmOfficina.role: I designed the CRM architecture by analyzing workshop processes and defining features for customer, vehicle, service, and maintenance management.
crmOfficina.outcome: Build a simple and intuitive vertical CRM that improves service traceability and provides a complete maintenance history for every vehicle.

hospitality.title: Hospitality Management Platform with Intelligent Pricing
hospitality.challenge: A hospitality business needed to centralize reservations coming from multiple booking platforms while improving pricing decisions through market and competitor analysis.
hospitality.role: I designed the solution architecture, analyzed operational processes, and defined the workflows for booking platform integration and pricing strategy support.
hospitality.outcome: Create a centralized system to simplify room management, reduce manual tasks, and support more effective pricing strategies.

offGridHome.title: Off-grid Smart Home System for Energy and Security Management
offGridHome.challenge: A home independent from the electrical grid required an integrated system to monitor energy, security, and digital services through local devices and automated solutions.
offGridHome.role: I designed and configured the technology architecture by integrating NAS systems, video surveillance, security systems, energy management through inverters, and multimedia services.
offGridHome.outcome: Create a reliable and autonomous home ecosystem for managing security, energy, and personal digital content.

farmacovigilanza.title: Software for Pharmacovigilance and Adverse Reaction Reporting
farmacovigilanza.challenge: As part of a university thesis in a hospital environment, it was necessary to design a software system for collecting and organizing adverse drug and vaccine reaction reports from healthcare professionals.
farmacovigilanza.role: I analyzed the application domain, designed the software model, and developed a solution for structured data collection and clinical information management.
farmacovigilanza.outcome: Create a digital tool supporting pharmacovigilance activities by improving the quality and traceability of collected reports.

about.name: Software Engineer and Solution Architect with experience in complex projects.
about.description:
I turn business goals into practical digital solutions that are reliable and scalable.
I work with companies and professionals to streamline processes, reduce inefficiencies, and build products that create measurable value.
I combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, from architecture decisions to delivery and continuous improvement.

How I can help:
• Custom Software Development: web and mobile applications built around your needs.
• Strategic Consulting: clearer and more sustainable technology decisions.
• Project & Tech Leadership: technical and operational coordination for effective delivery.
• Optimization & Innovation: continuous improvement of tools, workflows, and performance.

items.title: FULL STACK DEVELOPMENT
items.description: Development of complete web and mobile applications, handling frontend, backend, and integrations with modern and scalable technologies.
items.details:
Complete Web and Mobile Applications

I provide full stack development services, managing every technical aspect of the project: from architecture design to development, deployment, and ongoing evolution.

I work on both the frontend, creating modern and intuitive interfaces, and the backend, developing robust, secure, and scalable application logic. When needed, I also deliver mobile applications integrated with existing systems.

Technologies I use

Frontend: React, Vue.js, Angular; Backend: Node.js, .NET; Mobile: React Native. Technology is never an end, but a tool: if the project requires it, I evaluate and use different stacks.

What I deliver

  • Custom web applications
  • Corporate and management platforms
  • Backend APIs and services
  • Integrations with external systems (CRM, ERP, payments, cloud services)
  • Cross-platform mobile applications
  • Refactoring and optimization of existing projects

Who can benefit

  • Companies looking to digitize processes or build custom solutions
  • Startups needing a solid and scalable product
  • Technical teams seeking expert support in frontend, backend, or architecture
  • Entrepreneurs and professionals looking for a single reliable technical reference

items.title: CONSULTING
items.description: Evaluation of your IT needs and personalized strategies.
items.details:
IT and Technology Consulting

Clarity, strategy, and informed technical decisions

I offer IT consulting services to help companies, startups, software houses, and web agencies make solid technology decisions, reducing risks, time waste, and unnecessary costs. The consulting process transforms business needs into sustainable, aligned technical solutions.

What consulting includes

I assist clients and teams in all decision-making stages, providing a clear and independent technical perspective:

  • Analysis of business needs and objectives
  • Evaluation of software architectures and technology stacks
  • Support in defining technical roadmaps
  • Informed technology choices (stack, framework, cloud, integrations)
  • Review of existing or planned solutions
  • Support for CTOs, PMs, and non-technical stakeholders

When consulting is useful

  • Starting a new project and wanting a solid foundation
  • Existing projects that do not scale or perform adequately
  • Uncertainty about which technologies to adopt
  • Evaluating vendors or alternative solutions
  • Needing a second technical opinion before major decisions

Who benefits

  • Companies seeking more effective technology decisions
  • Startups validating ideas and architectures
  • Software houses needing external technical advice
  • Web agencies requiring strategic support for complex projects
  • Entrepreneurs and decision-makers seeking clarity without unnecessary technicalities

items.title: PROJECT MANAGEMENT & TECH LEAD
items.description: Complete management of complex technology projects.
items.details:
Project Management & Tech Lead

Comprehensive management of complex technology projects

I offer Project Management and Tech Lead services, supporting companies, startups, software houses, and web agencies in managing and coordinating IT projects of any complexity. The goal is to ensure on-time delivery, budget adherence, and technically solid solutions, with a single technical and strategic reference.

What I do concretely

  • Planning, organizing, and managing technology projects
  • Coordinating internal teams and external vendors
  • Technical supervision as Tech Lead on architecture and development
  • Defining roadmaps and project milestones
  • Monitoring progress and managing risks
  • Optimizing processes and tools to increase productivity and quality

When it’s useful

  • Projects must meet deadlines and budgets
  • Distributed teams or external vendors need coordination
  • Rapid and informed technical decisions are needed
  • Need a single point of contact understanding both business and technology
  • Strategic support is required for product evolution

Who benefits

  • Companies seeking professionally managed IT projects
  • Startups needing an expert Tech Lead to guide development
  • Software houses and web agencies needing project or team coordination support
  • Technical teams aiming to optimize workflows and processes
  • Entrepreneurs and decision-makers seeking clarity and control over tech development

My approach

My approach combines rigorous project management with technical consulting: I not only coordinate but ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business goals. The focus is always on transparency, clear communication, and tangible results.

items.title: B2B RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT
items.description: Optimizing collaboration before, during, and after sales.
items.details:
B2B Relationship Management

Optimizing collaboration before, during, and after sales

I provide B2B Relationship Management services for companies, software houses, and web agencies, helping them improve communication and collaboration with clients and vendors. The goal is to ensure clear processes, strong partnerships, and productive relationships, reducing friction, inefficiencies, and operational issues.

What I do concretely

  • Coordinating and optimizing client and vendor relationships
  • Managing the pre-sales cycle: needs analysis, proposals, objective setting
  • Managing the post-sales cycle: support, follow-up, satisfaction monitoring, feedback management
  • Creating clear processes and standardized procedures
  • Improving communication between internal teams and external partners
  • Supporting conflict resolution or critical issues in B2B relationships

When it’s useful

  • Relationships with clients or vendors are fragmented or unclear
  • You want to increase efficiency, collaboration, and partner satisfaction
  • Strategic support in managing pre- and post-sales cycles is needed
  • You want to reduce errors, delays, or misunderstandings between teams, clients, and vendors
  • A single point of contact is necessary to coordinate communication and processes

Who benefits

  • Companies seeking to improve commercial and operational interactions
  • Startups managing clients and vendors in a structured way to grow quickly
  • Software houses and web agencies wanting to optimize client and partner relationships
  • Sales or technical teams needing clear processes and efficient coordination
  • Entrepreneurs and managers seeking control and visibility over all B2B relationships

My approach

My approach combines organizational management, effective communication, and practical strategies. I don’t just coordinate relationships, I create sustainable processes that reduce friction, improve partner satisfaction, and increase overall productivity.

items.title: TRAINING
items.description: I organize courses on technologies and best practices to improve internal skills.
items.details:
Technology Training

Enhancing internal skills and boosting your team

I offer training on technologies, methodologies, and IT best practices, designed for companies, startups, software houses, and web agencies. The goal is to make teams more autonomous, efficient, and up-to-date, improving project quality and reducing dependence on external consultants.

What I do concretely

  • Customized courses on frontend, backend, and mobile development
  • Training on software architectures, integrations, and APIs
  • Workshops on agile methodologies, project management, and DevOps
  • Practical sessions on React, Vue, Angular, Node.js, .NET, React Native
  • Supporting teams during real projects to transfer practical skills
  • Providing personalized documentation and training materials

When it’s useful

  • Internal teams need technological updates
  • You want to reduce dependence on external consultants
  • Improving processes, quality, and productivity is required
  • New technologies or methodologies need to be introduced in the company
  • You want to boost professional growth of team members

Who benefits

  • Internal teams of companies and startups wanting to grow quickly
  • Software houses and web agencies updating staff or transferring project-specific skills
  • Entrepreneurs and managers wanting to strengthen strategic and technical skills of their team
  • Junior teams or new hires needing effective onboarding

My approach

Training combines theory and practice, with a modular approach tailored to the team’s needs. I don’t just explain technologies, I teach how to apply them in real projects to create immediately usable skills.
